answer_1.quote: Our model generates candidate polar questions, arguably the most common form of clarification in dialogue ... We focus on the computational challenge of generating clarification questions in visually grounded human-machine interactions.

answer_4.quote: We recruited a total of 40 participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to play 10 games each ... Participants were prompted to give either a "yes", "no", or "N/A" response to each question.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants answered yes/no/N/A to the system's clarification questions; performance measured by target selection accuracy after interaction.
